# Super ii

> Super ii is a public AI collaboration hub for models, datasets, browser apps, community discussions, collections, and provenance.

The public catalog intentionally contains no seeded models, datasets, or apps. Real repositories appear only after their files pass automated security and format checks plus human review. Account access supports email, Google, and GitHub. Upload and publishing paths fail closed whenever the separate self-hosted runtime is not ready.

## Agent access

- [MCP](https://superii.site/mcp): Stateless, public, read-only Streamable HTTP tools
- [Agent contract](https://superii.site/agents.md): Global automation rules and safety boundaries
- [System state JSON](https://superii.site/system-state.json): Canonical capability and availability register
- [System state Markdown](https://superii.site/system-state.md): Human-readable source register
- [Repository manifest schema](https://superii.site/schemas/repository-manifest-v1.json): Versioned reviewed-release manifest contract
- [Repository API schema](https://superii.site/schemas/repository-api-v1.json): Versioned machine-resource and download contract
- [Use Manifest schema](https://superii.site/schemas/use-manifest-v1.json): Per-model deterministic execution contract
- [Runtime registry](https://superii.site/runtime-registry.json): Reviewed libraries, runtimes, desktop apps, API servers, agents, notebooks, and verification dates
- [Runtime registry schema](https://superii.site/schemas/runtime-registry-v1.json): Versioned registry validation contract

Every reviewed repository exposes README.md, agents.md, manifest.json, api, and mcp resources beneath its canonical URL. Reviewed models also expose use.json, use.md, use.ipynb, and use.sh from that same immutable revision. Default repository URLs also negotiate text/markdown and application/json. Public paper pages expose Markdown and JSON representations.

- [Home](https://superii.site/): Product overview and launch principles

- [Organizations](https://superii.site/organizations): Team collaboration overview
